_comment: What each host loads and observes, measured on the versions named; read by hooks/lib/healthcheck.sh. A declared handler on an event the host does not load is not an active function, and this file is where that is said. Provenance in tests/fixtures/hosts/PROVENANCE.md.

codex.source: codex app-server generate-json-schema 0.154.0; the released event list (codex-rs/hooks/src/lib.rs, rust-v0.154.0) read by a Codex session qualifying this plugin 2026-09-20, which named Interrupt as a twelfth kind and PermissionRequest and SubagentStart as supported; audit CR-117 hooks/list 14 of 17
codex.trust: installing and enabling a plugin does not trust its hooks: the 14 handlers loaded from this manifest were reported trustStatus=untrusted until reviewed (/hooks), or bypassed for one invocation with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust
codex.async_continuation: a background hook cannot force a continuation: exit 2 and asyncRewake are Claude Code's, and unfinished background hooks are cancelled at shutdown. A verdict that must be acted on belongs in a synchronous gate
codex.native_agents: 0.155.1 plugin manifest loads skills, MCP, apps and hooks; role loader reads config layers and their agents directories, not plugin agent directories. Missions can be read from agents/ without importing roles.
codex.native_manifest: .codex-plugin/plugin.json: 22 skills and 14 hooks read on 0.155.1 with no Claude manifest. Portable root plugin.json masks this native entry point and intentionally excludes hooks in this host version.

grok.plugin_hooks_note: A fresh process on 1.0.40 does not run plugin-bundled hooks. Measured 2026-09-21: hooks.json stays hookType file, and an inline PreToolUse hook stayed hookType inline while grok -p wrote the target file and the hook marker stayed empty. The gate that runs is ~/.grok/hooks/craftsman.json from craftsman-ci export --target grok-hooks, which bin/craftsman-grok-install writes. A reload in /hooks was measured on 1.0.34 and is not startup parity. SessionStart is not replayed.
grok.source: ~/.grok/docs/user-guide/10-hooks.md (1.0.30 event list still holds on 1.0.40) for the event list, the captured events for the payload; TaskCompleted and FileChanged are not events Grok fires. grok --version on 2026-09-21: 1.0.40 (eb1a2256660d)
grok.trust: a project hooks file runs only once the folder is trusted (--trust, or /hooks-trust): untrusted, it is skipped in silence and every forbidden write lands (measured 2026-09-20)
grok.refusal_rendering: a hook that exits 2 shows as failed in Grok's hook_execution rows: that is a refusal, not a broken hook
grok.native_reload: 1.0.34: native plugin enabled/trusted and hookCount=1, but hooks/list initially has no plugin handler. Native hooks/action reload adds the handler; a native PreToolUse control then accepts good-native-control.txt and denies bad-native-control.txt before disk (2026-09-21). Initial SessionStart remains missed; this is not automatic startup parity.

event_functions.TaskCompleted: evidence gate before a task is marked complete (task-completed-verify.sh)
event_functions.PostToolUseFailure: failed tool tracking and test-failure revocation (tool-failure-tracker.sh, post-bash-test-verify.sh)
event_functions.FileChanged: external edit tracking for correction learning (file-changed.sh)
